# Perfect Design (@perfect-design/ui)

> Universal Vue 3 + Tailwind 4 + reka-ui component library and design system. Semantic tokens (shadcn-compatible), CVA variants, `class` prop always wins, `as`/`asChild`, `data-slot` hooks. Icons are FontAwesome IconDefinitions.

## Rules
- Import from `@perfect-design/ui`; use semantic tokens only (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-primary, border-border…); never raw colours.
- Override styling only through the `class` prop; reuse `xVariants()` helpers for non-component elements.
- Wrap form controls in `Field`; give icon-only buttons an aria-label; Dialogs need a DialogTitle.
- Avoid the LLM tells in LLMSlop.md: no gradients, glass, glows, tracked all-caps eyebrows, hover lift, buzzwords, stock labels ("Get started", "Learn more"), emoji or invented people, quotes and numbers. Follow DESIGN.md.

## Start here
- [Getting started](/guides/getting-started): install, CSS wiring, first component
- [Customisation contract](/guides/customisation): class, variant, size, as, data-slot
- [Using with LLMs](/guides/llm): prompt and rules for generating UI
- [Colour tokens](/foundations/colors): every semantic token and its role
- [Style packs](/foundations/styles): workbench, tactile, editorial, raw, contrast and terminal looks via data-style
- [Every component in detail](/llms-full.txt): props, slots, events, rules and examples for all components in one file
- [Component manifest](/components.manifest.json): the same data as JSON

## primitives
- [Button](/components/primitives/button): Triggers an action or navigation. The single button used everywhere in the system. (Buttons)
- [IconButton](/components/primitives/icon-button): Square icon-only Button with a required accessible label and tooltip title. (Buttons)
- [Chip](/components/primitives/chip): Compact tag that can be removable and/or selectable (toggle). (Chips)
- [ShowMore](/components/primitives/show-more): Collapses long content to a number of lines or a height and shows a Show more toggle only when it overflows. (Disclosure)
- [Avatar](/components/primitives/avatar): Shows a user or entity as an image with an initials fallback and an optional status dot. (Display)
- [AvatarGroup](/components/primitives/avatar-group): Overlapping stack of avatars with a +N overflow bubble. (Display)
- [Icon](/components/primitives/icon): Inline SVG renderer for FontAwesome-shaped icon data, decorative by default. (Display)
- [Kbd](/components/primitives/kbd): Keyboard key chip (`<kbd>`) and a group that joins keys with a separator. (Display)
- [Separator](/components/primitives/separator): Thin horizontal or vertical divider line, solid, dashed or dotted, optionally with a label ("or", "Today") on the line. (Display)
- [Skeleton](/components/primitives/skeleton): Placeholder block shown while content loads: text, circle, avatar, pill, rounded, rect and paragraph shapes with a pulse or no animation. (Display)
- [Spinner](/components/primitives/spinner): Small rotating SVG that shows work in progress, with an accessible label or as a purely visual mark. (Display)
- [AspectRatio](/components/primitives/aspect-ratio): Keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height ratio (images, video, maps, placeholders). (Layout helpers)
- [ScrollArea](/components/primitives/scroll-area): Scrollable region with consistent, themed scrollbars across browsers. (Layout helpers)
- [VisuallyHidden](/components/primitives/visually-hidden): Hides content visually while keeping it available to screen readers. (Layout helpers)
- [Link](/components/primitives/link): Inline text link with variants, safe external handling and RouterLink support. (Links)
- [Badge](/components/primitives/badge): Small non-interactive label for status, counts and categories. (Status)
- [CountBadge](/components/primitives/count-badge): Numeric count pill or small dot for unread items and pending work, with a required accessible label. (Status)
- [Progress](/components/primitives/progress): Horizontal progress bar with determinate and indeterminate modes, tones, sizes, a pulse animation, inside/top labels and segments. (Status)
- [ProgressRing](/components/primitives/progress-ring): Circular SVG meter that fills clockwise from the top, with a centre label. (Status)
- [StatusBadge](/components/primitives/status-badge): Badge that maps a raw status string (active, pending, failed...) to a tone, with a leading dot. (Status)
- [StatusDot](/components/primitives/status-dot): Small coloured dot that signals a state (online, failing, pending), optionally pulsing. (Status)
- [Toggle](/components/primitives/toggle): Two-state button that stays pressed (bold, mute, pin). Controlled or uncontrolled. (Toggles)
- [ToggleGroup](/components/primitives/toggle-group): Joined set of toggle buttons (default, outline or segmented look) with single or multiple selection and roving keyboard focus. (Toggles)

## typography
- [Markdown](/components/typography/markdown): Renders Markdown text (CommonMark plus GFM tables, task lists and strikethrough) as styled, accessible elements without v-html. (Prose)
- [Prose](/components/typography/prose): Wrapper that styles raw HTML content (headings, lists, links, code, tables, images) with design tokens. (Prose)
- [Blockquote](/components/typography/blockquote): Quoted passage in five variants (left border, tinted, card, pull-quote) with a citation footer or an author row (avatar, name, role). (Text)
- [Eyebrow](/components/typography/eyebrow): Small plain label placed above a heading. (Text)
- [FormattedNumber](/components/typography/formatted-number): A locale-aware number, percentage, currency amount, unit or compact figure rendered with Intl.NumberFormat, with tabular figures and bidi isolation. (Text)
- [Heading](/components/typography/heading): Semantic h1-h6 heading with independent visual size, underline/divider decoration and optional eyebrow and description. (Text)
- [InlineCode](/components/typography/inline-code): Inline <code> snippet with a muted background and monospace font. (Text)
- [Lead](/components/typography/lead): Large muted intro paragraph that follows a page or section title. (Text)
- [RelativeTime](/components/typography/relative-time): A `<time>` element that writes a moment as relative text ("3 minutes ago", "in 2 days") with the absolute date in the tooltip, optionally kept fresh by one shared timer. (Text)
- [Text](/components/typography/text): Body text with variant presets, size, tone, weight, leading, transform, wrapping, alignment and truncation or line clamping. (Text)

## layout
- [ConfigProvider](/components/layout/config-provider): Sets text direction, locale, time zone, motion override, default size and density, and translated built-in strings for everything inside it. (Configuration)
- [Container](/components/layout/container): Constrains content to a max width, centres it and adds responsive horizontal padding. (Containers)
- [Section](/components/layout/section): Page section with vertical padding presets, optional tinted background and borders. (Containers)
- [AppShell](/components/layout/app-shell): Application frame with header, collapsible sidebar (drawer on mobile), main content and footer slots. (Page structure)
- [CenteredLayout](/components/layout/centered-layout): Full-height page that centres a narrow column, for sign-in, empty and error pages. (Page structure)
- [PageHeader](/components/layout/page-header): Page title block with description, breadcrumb, back link, tabs, actions, centered / compact / hero variants and optional sticky mode. (Page structure)
- [ResizablePanels](/components/layout/resizable-panels): Two or more panels separated by draggable, keyboard-accessible handles; sizes are percentages that always add up to 100. (Page structure)
- [SplitLayout](/components/layout/split-layout): Two-pane layout (start / end) with ratio presets, fixed-width pane and responsive stacking. (Page structure)
- [Affix](/components/layout/affix): Pins content with `position: sticky` and reports whether it is currently stuck. (Scrolling)
- [InfiniteScroll](/components/layout/infinite-scroll): Fires `load` when the end of a list scrolls into view; handles loading, end-of-list and error-with-retry states. (Scrolling)
- [Grid](/components/layout/grid): CSS grid with 1-12 columns, per-breakpoint column counts and a gap scale. (Stacks & grids)
- [Spacer](/components/layout/spacer): Flexible (flex-1) or fixed-size empty space for use inside flex layouts. (Stacks & grids)
- [Stack](/components/layout/stack): Flex container that lays children out in a row or column with consistent gaps. (Stacks & grids)
- [StyleScope](/components/layout/style-scope): Applies one style pack (density, corners, depth, type) to everything inside it. (Style packs)

## forms
- [FormActions](/components/forms/form-actions): Aligned row of form actions (submit and cancel) with an optional sticky bottom bar and stacking on small screens. (Actions)
- [Checkbox](/components/forms/checkbox): Boolean (or indeterminate) checkbox with optional label and description, sizes, tones, shapes, invalid state and Field wiring. (Choice)
- [CheckboxCard](/components/forms/checkbox-card): Selectable card tile backed by a native checkbox, with title, description, icon slots, variants, tones, a stacked layout and a group for multi-select lists. (Choice)
- [MultiSelect](/components/forms/multi-select): Dropdown checkbox list with chips summary, search filter, select all / clear, max selections and full keyboard support. (Choice)
- [RadioCard](/components/forms/radio-card): Selectable card tile backed by a native radio input, used inside RadioCardGroup for single-choice options with tones, a stacked layout and roving arrow-key navigation. (Choice)
- [RadioGroup](/components/forms/radio-group): Single-choice group of radio items with roving keyboard focus, labels, descriptions, sizes, tones and Field wiring. (Choice)
- [SegmentedControl](/components/forms/segmented-control): Compact single choice (view switcher, range picker) built on a radiogroup, in pill, underline, outline or filled looks, horizontal or vertical. (Choice)
- [Switch](/components/forms/switch): On/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately, with optional label and description, sizes, tones and on/off icons. (Choice)
- [ColorPicker](/components/forms/color-picker): Swatch palette plus validated hex input; emits normalised lowercase hex colours. (Choice inputs)
- [Rating](/components/forms/rating): Rating input from 0 to N icons (star, heart, circle) with half or quarter steps, tones, keyboard support and slider semantics. (Choice inputs)
- [Calendar](/components/forms/calendar): Accessible month grid with single, range or multiple day selection, min/max/disabled dates, locale names and full keyboard navigation. (Date & time)
- [DatePicker](/components/forms/date-picker): Input-like button that opens a dropdown Calendar to pick a single date, formatted with Intl. (Date & time)
- [DateRangePicker](/components/forms/date-range-picker): Input-like button that opens a dropdown Calendar to pick a start and end date, with an optional two-month view. (Date & time)
- [TimeInput](/components/forms/time-input): Segmented HH:mm time field with arrow-key stepping, digit typing, optional 12h AM/PM, min/max, minute step, variants, shapes and status. (Date & time)
- [TimeRangePicker](/components/forms/time-range-picker): Pick a time window from presets (last 15 minutes to 30 days, today, yesterday) or a custom from and to, as a popover, an inline panel or a segmented row, in an explicit time zone. (Date & time)
- [Field](/components/forms/field): Form-field wrapper: label, control, hint and error with automatic id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid wiring. (Field wrappers)
- [Label](/components/forms/label): Accessible form label with optional required indicator and disabled style. (Field wrappers)
- [FilterBar](/components/forms/filter-bar): A row of applied filters as removable chips with an "Add filter" popover, "Clear all", a polite live region and URL-query helpers. (Filtering)
- [FieldGroup](/components/forms/field-group): Layout wrapper that stacks or grids several Fields with a consistent gap. (Layout)
- [Fieldset](/components/forms/fieldset): Native fieldset with legend and description that groups related controls and can disable them all at once. (Layout)
- [FormSection](/components/forms/form-section): Titled form section landmark with description, optional aside actions, divider and a responsive 1-4 column fields grid. (Layout)
- [Combobox](/components/forms/combobox): Type-to-filter single select over an options array with clear button, empty state and Field wiring. (Selection)
- [ModelPicker](/components/forms/model-picker): Searchable, grouped single choice over plain option data with a description and text badges per option. (Selection)
- [NativeSelect](/components/forms/native-select): Styled native <select> with chevron, options array or slot content, placeholder, variants, sizes, shapes, status and Field wiring. (Selection)
- [Select](/components/forms/select): Custom single-select dropdown with groups, labels, keyboard typeahead and Field wiring. (Selection)
- [Slider](/components/forms/slider): Pick a number or a numeric range by dragging a thumb or using the keyboard. (Selection)
- [CopyField](/components/forms/copy-field): Read-only value (API key, URL, token) with a joined copy-to-clipboard button, copied feedback, variants, sizes, shapes and status. (Text fields)
- [DateInput](/components/forms/date-input): Styled native date, time, datetime-local or month input with min/max validation messaging, variants, sizes, shapes and status. (Text fields)
- [Editable](/components/forms/editable): Inline editable text: click to edit, Enter saves, Escape cancels, blur saves (configurable). (Text fields)
- [Input](/components/forms/input): Single-line text field with v-model, variants (outline, filled, underline, ghost), sizes, shapes, status, prefix and suffix slots and automatic Field wiring. (Text fields)
- [InputGroup](/components/forms/input-group): Puts a prefix, a suffix or joined buttons around an Input, Textarea or NativeSelect so they share one field surface. (Text fields)
- [NumberInput](/components/forms/number-input): Numeric text field with -/+ steppers, clamping, keyboard stepping, float-safe arithmetic, variants, sizes, shapes and status. (Text fields)
- [PasswordInput](/components/forms/password-input): Password field with an accessible show/hide toggle, variants, sizes, shapes and status. (Text fields)
- [PinInput](/components/forms/pin-input): Segmented one-character-per-cell input for verification codes and PINs. (Text fields)
- [PromptInput](/components/forms/prompt-input): Auto-growing message box for chat style interfaces: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, a Stop button replaces Send while a reply is running. (Text fields)
- [SearchInput](/components/forms/search-input): Text field with a search icon, a clear button, Esc-to-clear and an optional debounced `search` event. (Text fields)
- [TagsInput](/components/forms/tags-input): Free-form list of short strings entered as removable chips. (Text fields)
- [Textarea](/components/forms/textarea): Multi-line text field with v-model, variants, sizes, shapes, status, optional autosize and character counter. (Text fields)
- [FileDropzone](/components/forms/file-dropzone): Drag-and-drop or click-to-browse file picker with type, size and count validation. Selection only, no upload. (Upload)

## feedback
- [ConfirmDialog](/components/feedback/confirm-dialog): Confirm / cancel dialog with destructive styling and async-aware confirm, plus a promise-based useConfirm() host. (Confirmation)
- [Alert](/components/feedback/alert): Inline, in-flow status message with optional icon, title, description and dismiss button. (Messages)
- [Banner](/components/feedback/banner): Full-width, page-level notice with optional sticky position, action slot and remembered dismissal. (Messages)
- [Callout](/components/feedback/callout): Documentation-style note, tip, important, warning, caution, danger, success, quote or example block with a tinted surface and a status icon. (Messages)
- [InlineMessage](/components/feedback/inline-message): One-line, field-level message with a tone-coloured icon. (Messages)
- [NotificationList](/components/feedback/notification-list): Inbox-style list of notifications with unread dots, relative times, mark-as-read, grouping and a collapsible tail. (Notifications)
- [AsyncBoundary](/components/feedback/async-boundary): Shows the right state for async content: loading, error with retry, empty or the content itself. (States)
- [EmptyState](/components/feedback/empty-state): Centred placeholder for lists, tables and views that have no content yet. (States)
- [ErrorState](/components/feedback/error-state): Failed-load placeholder with a message, retry button and collapsible technical details. (States)
- [LoadingState](/components/feedback/loading-state): Loading placeholder: spinner with label, or text / card / table / list / avatar-text / kpi-grid / form skeletons; optional full-page layout. (States)
- [OfflineIndicator](/components/feedback/offline-indicator): Shows a warning message while the browser is offline; renders nothing visible when online. (States)
- [StaleNotice](/components/feedback/stale-notice): Shows when data was last updated, turns into a warning once it is stale, with optional refresh button. (States)
- [Toaster](/components/feedback/toaster): Fixed-position, screen-reader-announced stack that renders the global toast store. (Toasts)
- [ToastItem](/components/feedback/toast-item): Presentational toast card: icon, title, description, optional action and dismiss button. (Toasts)

## overlays
- [HoverCard](/components/overlays/hover-card): Rich preview card that appears when hovering or focusing a link or element. (Floating)
- [Popover](/components/overlays/popover): Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger. Compound component built on reka-ui. (Floating)
- [Tooltip](/components/overlays/tooltip): Short text hint shown on hover or keyboard focus. Compound component plus a one-line `SimpleTooltip`. (Floating)
- [Tour](/components/overlays/tour): Step-by-step coach marks that spotlight page elements and explain them in a positioned card. (Guided tours)
- [Command](/components/overlays/command): Searchable command palette: an input that filters a keyboard-navigable list of items. Inline or inside a modal `CommandDialog`. (Menus)
- [ContextMenu](/components/overlays/context-menu): Right-click (long-press on touch) menu with items, checkboxes, radios, groups and nested sub menus. (Menus)
- [DropdownMenu](/components/overlays/dropdown-menu): Menu of actions opened from a button, with items, checkboxes, radios, groups and nested sub menus. (Menus)
- [AlertDialog](/components/overlays/alert-dialog): Modal confirmation that interrupts the user and requires an explicit Cancel or Action choice. (Modals)
- [Dialog](/components/overlays/dialog): Modal window that blocks the page until dismissed. Compound component built on reka-ui. (Modals)
- [Sheet](/components/overlays/sheet): Modal panel that slides in from the top, right, bottom or left edge. Compound component built on reka-ui Dialog. (Modals)
- [ShortcutsDialog](/components/overlays/shortcuts-dialog): Help dialog that lists the keyboard shortcuts of a page, grouped, with keys drawn as Kbd chips. Opens with `?` by default. (Modals)

## navigation
- [BackToTop](/components/navigation/back-to-top): Floating button that appears after scrolling down and scrolls the window back to the top. (Accessibility)
- [SkipLink](/components/navigation/skip-link): Visually hidden "Skip to main content" link that appears on keyboard focus. (Accessibility)
- [AppHeader](/components/navigation/app-header): Top bar with brand, navigation and action slots, an optional sticky mode and a built-in mobile menu. (App shell)
- [MobileNav](/components/navigation/mobile-nav): Small-screen navigation panel: slides down under a header or opens as a side sheet. Esc closes and focus is managed. (App shell)
- [SidebarNav](/components/navigation/sidebar-nav): Grouped application sidebar navigation with icons, badges, nested items and an icon-only collapsed mode. (App shell)
- [DocsSidebar](/components/navigation/docs-sidebar): Documentation-style grouped link list with section titles and an active page indicator. (Docs)
- [TableOfContents](/components/navigation/table-of-contents): In-page "On this page" list that highlights the section being read and scrolls to a section on click. (Docs)
- [NavLink](/components/navigation/nav-link): Navigation link with an active state (aria-current), optional icon and badge. Router-agnostic. (Links)
- [Menubar](/components/navigation/menubar): Desktop-style horizontal menu bar (File, Edit, View) whose menus open from triggers with full keyboard roving. (Menus)
- [NavigationMenu](/components/navigation/navigation-menu): Site navigation bar with hover/click mega-menu panels, an optional shared viewport and an optional indicator. (Menus)
- [Toolbar](/components/navigation/toolbar): A row or column of related controls that is one tab stop and moves focus with the arrow keys (WAI-ARIA toolbar). (Menus)
- [Pagination](/components/navigation/pagination): Page navigation with first/prev/next/last, sibling window and ellipses. Compact "Page X of Y" on small screens. (Paging)
- [Stepper](/components/navigation/stepper): Shows progress through a multi-step flow, horizontal or vertical, optionally clickable. (Progress)
- [Accordion](/components/navigation/accordion): Vertically stacked sections that expand and collapse. Single or multiple open items. Built on reka-ui. (Tabs & disclosure)
- [Collapsible](/components/navigation/collapsible): A single show/hide region with an animated reveal. Built on reka-ui. (Tabs & disclosure)
- [Tabs](/components/navigation/tabs): Switch between related panels of content without leaving the page. Compound component built on reka-ui. (Tabs & disclosure)
- [AccentPicker](/components/navigation/accent-picker): Radio group of colour swatches that switches the accent preset (`data-theme`). (Theme)
- [StylePicker](/components/navigation/style-picker): Radio group that switches the style pack (`data-style`) of the whole page. (Theme)
- [ThemeToggle](/components/navigation/theme-toggle): Button that cycles the colour mode light → dark → system and shows the matching icon. (Theme)
- [Breadcrumb](/components/navigation/breadcrumb): Shows the path to the current page. Items-array API or compound parts, with middle-item truncation. (Wayfinding)

## data-display
- [BoardCard](/components/data-display/board-card): Draggable card for a BoardColumn, with a keyboard alternative (Alt + arrow keys) to dragging. (Boards)
- [BoardColumn](/components/data-display/board-column): Kanban-style column that accepts dragged BoardCards and reports where they were dropped. (Boards)
- [BarChart](/components/data-display/bar-chart): Dependency-free SVG bar chart: grouped or stacked, vertical or horizontal, rounded or square bars, optional value labels and grid styles, with axis, legend and per-bar tooltips. (Charts)
- [BulletChart](/components/data-display/bullet-chart): Bullet chart: one thin measure bar against a target marker and qualitative range bands, for one or several stacked measures. (Charts)
- [CalendarHeatmap](/components/data-display/calendar-heatmap): Contribution-style calendar: one cell per day, weeks as columns and weekdays as rows, with month labels, a legend and a month table for assistive technology. (Charts)
- [DonutChart](/components/data-display/donut-chart): Dependency-free SVG donut or half donut showing parts of a whole, with a centre total and a legend of values and percentages that sits beside or under the ring. (Charts)
- [FunnelChart](/components/data-display/funnel-chart): Dependency-free SVG funnel chart with funnel, pyramid, bars and steps variants, vertical or horizontal layout, conversion rates, labels inside or beside the shapes and non-monotone data. (Charts)
- [Heatmap](/components/data-display/heatmap): Accessible grid heatmap (commit calendar, activity by hour) with intensity levels, labels, legend and cell tooltips. (Charts)
- [LineChart](/components/data-display/line-chart): Dependency-free SVG line chart with multiple series, nice y ticks, linear, smooth or step curves, optional area fill and markers, grid styles, gaps for missing values and tooltips on dots. (Charts)
- [NetworkGraph](/components/data-display/network-graph): Dependency-free node-link diagram with four deterministic layouts, group colours with marker shapes, arrowheads, hulls and a text alternative. (Charts)
- [RadarChart](/components/data-display/radar-chart): Dependency-free SVG radar (spider) chart with three or more axes, several series, line, area or dots variants, polygon or circular rings, 3 to 6 levels and a configurable scale. (Charts)
- [Sankey](/components/data-display/sankey): Flow diagram: nodes in layers joined by ribbons whose width is the amount that flows, with a table of flows as the text alternative. (Charts)
- [ScatterChart](/components/data-display/scatter-chart): Dependency-free SVG scatter, bubble and connected-scatter chart with several series, marker shapes per series, nice numeric axes, grid styles, axis titles and an optional linear trend line. (Charts)
- [Sparkline](/components/data-display/sparkline): Tiny inline trend (pure SVG) as a line, area, bar or win/loss strip, for tables, KPI tiles and lists. (Charts)
- [Treemap](/components/data-display/treemap): Hierarchical tile chart: area follows value, tiles are squarified, groups can be shown as nested containers, and every tile is keyboard reachable. (Charts)
- [WaterfallChart](/components/data-display/waterfall-chart): Dependency-free SVG waterfall chart: a start value, increases and decreases, subtotals and a total, as bars, steps or lollipops, vertical or horizontal, with connectors and a pattern or marker for decreases. (Charts)
- [ChatMessage](/components/data-display/chat-message): One chat message with a role, a bubble, plain or card surface, an avatar, a header, a status written as text and hover or focus actions. (Chat)
- [ChatThread](/components/data-display/chat-thread): Scrolling conversation log that follows the latest message, with day separators, a typing indicator, a jump button, older-message loading and one polite announcement region. (Chat)
- [CodeBlock](/components/data-display/code-block): Monospace code panel with copy button, line numbers, titled header and terminal frames, filename header and tabs, diff marks and line highlighting. (Code)
- [CodeViewer](/components/data-display/code-viewer): Read-only code viewer with built-in tokenizers for JSON, YAML, Go, TOML and shell, foldable regions, line numbers, line highlighting and a copy button. (Code)
- [DiffViewer](/components/data-display/diff-viewer): Read-only diff of two texts or a unified diff string, in unified, split or inline layout, with word highlights, folded unchanged lines and change-to-change navigation. (Code)
- [GoViewer](/components/data-display/go-viewer): Read-only Go viewer: show Go source with highlighting and folds, or render a JS value as a Go composite literal. (Code)
- [LogViewer](/components/data-display/log-viewer): Searchable, filterable log pane with level badges, ANSI colours, line selection, copy and a tail mode. (Code)
- [YamlViewer](/components/data-display/yaml-viewer): Read-only YAML viewer: show raw YAML text or serialise a JS value to YAML, with highlighting, indentation folds, line numbers and copy. (Code)
- [JsonViewer](/components/data-display/json-viewer): Collapsible, keyboard-navigable tree for inspecting any JS/JSON value with type-coloured leaves and copy-path. (Code and data)
- [Card](/components/data-display/card): Surface that groups related content, with header, content and footer parts. (Containers)
- [FlowCanvas](/components/data-display/flow-canvas): Interactive node and edge canvas: drag nodes, connect ports with the pointer or the keyboard, pan, zoom, undo, auto layout and a text alternative, drawn as one SVG with no extra dependency. (Diagrams)
- [MermaidDiagram](/components/data-display/mermaid-diagram): Draws Mermaid text (flowchart, sequence, pie, state, entity relationship, class, gantt, mindmap, timeline, journey) as an accessible SVG, with its own parser and layout and no extra dependency. (Diagrams)
- [Tree](/components/data-display/tree): Keyboard-navigable expandable tree with single selection, sizes, compact density, checkboxes, connector lines and a boxed variant. (Hierarchy)
- [ActivityFeed](/components/data-display/activity-feed): Chronological list of who did what to which thing and when, with relative times, day groups, expandable details and a load more button. (Lists)
- [DescriptionList](/components/data-display/description-list): Semantic term/definition pairs (`dl`) for showing record details, with optional copy buttons. (Lists)
- [List](/components/data-display/list): Vertical list of rows with leading/trailing slots, dividers and optional interactivity. (Lists)
- [Timeline](/components/data-display/timeline): Vertical sequence of events with status-toned markers, times and a connector line. (Lists)
- [VirtualList](/components/data-display/virtual-list): Fixed-row-height windowed list that renders only the visible rows, for 10 000+ items. (Lists)
- [Carousel](/components/data-display/carousel): Scroll-snap carousel with previous / next buttons, dots, keyboard control, optional loop and accessible autoplay. (Media)
- [StatBar](/components/data-display/stat-bar): Label + value + proportional bar for usage vs limit (quota, disk, budget). (Meters)
- [Leaderboard](/components/data-display/leaderboard): Ranked entries as a list, a table or a podium, with ties, deltas, proportional bars and a highlighted entry. (Rankings)
- [Gauge](/components/data-display/gauge): SVG gauge (semicircle, three-quarter arc or linear bar) for a value within a range, with threshold tones, a label and role=meter semantics. (Statistics)
- [KpiTile](/components/data-display/kpi-tile): Headline metric tile: label, value, trend delta with good/bad colouring, hint, icon and loading skeleton. (Statistics)
- [StatGroup](/components/data-display/stat-group): Responsive grid wrapper for KpiTile (or any tile) rows. (Statistics)
- [TrendBadge](/components/data-display/trend-badge): Compact up / down / flat change indicator with good-or-bad colouring, Intl formatting and screen-reader text. (Statistics)
- [DataGrid](/components/data-display/data-grid): Spreadsheet-like data grid: keyboard navigation over cells, inline editing with validation, sorting, resizable and pinned columns, row selection, copy as TSV and a windowed render for 10,000 rows. (Tables)
- [DataTable](/components/data-display/data-table): Data-array table with client-side sorting, row selection, pagination, loading and empty states. (Tables)
- [Table](/components/data-display/table): Styled, responsive native <table> with compound parts for hand-written tabular markup. (Tables)

## marketing
- [BlogCard](/components/marketing/blog-card): Article teaser card: cover image, category badge, title link, excerpt and author/date/read-time meta. (Blog)
- [BlogGrid](/components/marketing/blog-grid): Responsive 1-4 column grid of BlogCards from a posts array, with an optional featured first post. (Blog)
- [ScrollProgress](/components/marketing/scroll-progress): Thin reading-progress bar pinned to the top or bottom of the viewport. (Chrome)
- [ContactLink](/components/marketing/contact-link): mailto: or tel: link with a leading icon, as an inline link, a button (filled, outline or ghost) or a card. (Contact)
- [ContactSection](/components/marketing/contact-section): Contact page section: heading plus a `form` slot and a `details` slot in split, centered, card or inline layouts. (Contact)
- [SocialLinks](/components/marketing/social-links): Row or column of icon-only links to social/profile pages in plain, outline, filled or ghost styles, each with an aria-label. (Contact)
- [FaqList](/components/marketing/faq-list): Accessible FAQ accordion built on native <details>/<summary> in six layouts. (Content)
- [InstallTabs](/components/marketing/install-tabs): Tabbed install/code snippets with a copy button. (Content)
- [NumberedSteps](/components/marketing/numbered-steps): Numbered steps for how-it-works and onboarding sequences: cards, timeline, horizontal, minimal or with media. (Content)
- [FeatureCard](/components/marketing/feature-card): Card that presents one feature: icon, title, description and optional link, in eight variants. (Features)
- [FeatureGrid](/components/marketing/feature-grid): Feature section in six layouts (grid, list, alternating, bento, centered, with-heading) built from an items array or slot content. (Features)
- [NewsletterSignup](/components/marketing/newsletter-signup): Single-field email signup with validation; the parent performs the request and drives `status`. (Forms)
- [BeforeAfter](/components/marketing/before-after): Image comparison slider, horizontal or vertical: drag or use the keyboard to reveal the before and after images. (Media)
- [ImageGrid](/components/marketing/image-grid): Image gallery as a uniform grid, masonry or featured layout that opens a Lightbox on click. (Media)
- [Lightbox](/components/marketing/lightbox): Full-screen image viewer dialog with previous/next, Esc, focus containment and scroll lock. (Media)
- [Marquee](/components/marketing/marquee): Infinite CSS ticker (horizontal or vertical) for logos or short text, paused on hover and focus. (Motion)
- [SectionReveal](/components/marketing/section-reveal): Opt-in wrapper that fades its content in (rising, dropping or sliding sideways) when scrolled into view. Does nothing unless `enabled`. (Motion)
- [CookieConsent](/components/marketing/cookie-consent): Cookie notice with per-category toggles and equally prominent accept and reject buttons; it stores nothing and emits `change`. (Notices)
- [ComparisonTable](/components/marketing/comparison-table): Generic feature matrix: a real table of columns x features with check, cross, text and empty cells, grouping, a highlighted column and sticky options. (Pricing)
- [PricingCard](/components/marketing/pricing-card): Single pricing plan: name, monthly/yearly price, feature checklist, badge and CTA slot, in five variants. (Pricing)
- [PricingGrid](/components/marketing/pricing-grid): Responsive grid of PricingCards from a plans array, with a per-plan CTA slot and an optional monthly/yearly billing toggle. (Pricing)
- [PricingTable](/components/marketing/pricing-table): Pricing comparison table: plans as columns (price, badge, CTA), features as rows with check/cross/text cells and an optional billing toggle. (Pricing)
- [CtaBand](/components/marketing/cta-band): Call-to-action section in 5 layouts (band, card, split, inline, newsletter) and 3 flat tones. (Sections)
- [Hero](/components/marketing/hero): Page-top hero with 14 layouts, 4 backgrounds, 3 sizes, media frames, stats, logos, a form slot and bento tiles. (Sections)
- [MediaFrame](/components/marketing/media-frame): Browser, window, phone or plain frame around a real screenshot or code block. (Sections)
- [SectionHeading](/components/marketing/section-heading): Optional eyebrow, title, description and actions that introduce a page section, in 3 alignments, 4 sizes and 2 eyebrow styles. (Sections)
- [SiteFooter](/components/marketing/site-footer): Marketing footer in 7 variants (columns, simple, centered, minimal, newsletter, mega, split) with sizes, alignment and default, muted or dark tones. (Site chrome)
- [SiteHeader](/components/marketing/site-header): Marketing header in 7 variants (default, centered, minimal, transparent, floating, with-announcement, stacked) with sizes, tones, borders, link groups and a mobile menu. (Site chrome)
- [LogoCloud](/components/marketing/logo-cloud): Logos (or names) as a grid, inline row, marquee, split, centered or card strip, in grayscale, muted or colour, with optional bordered tiles. (Social proof)
- [Testimonial](/components/marketing/testimonial): Customer quote with author, role, avatar and optional star rating in six layouts. (Social proof)
- [TestimonialGrid](/components/marketing/testimonial-grid): Wall of testimonials in a grid, masonry or side-by-side columns layout. (Social proof)
- [TestimonialSlider](/components/marketing/testimonial-slider): Swipeable testimonial carousel built on CSS scroll-snap, no JavaScript carousel engine. (Social proof)
- [StatCounter](/components/marketing/stat-counter): Inline number with prefix, suffix, locale formatting and tabular figures. Static: it does not count up. (Stats)
- [StatGrid](/components/marketing/stat-grid): Headline numbers with labels in five layouts, optional icons and trend indicators. Numbers are static. (Stats)
- [TeamGrid](/components/marketing/team-grid): Responsive 2/3/4-column grid of team member cards with avatar or initials, role, bio and links. (Team)
